title: "simulate_n_bruschowsky_patients"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(deSolve, tidyverse, testthat, here)
source(here::here("R/functions.R"))
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)

sigma = 0.025

best_fits <- get_n_best_fits(3)

top_n_sims <- simulate_patients(best_fits, sigma = sigma)

top_n_sims_long <- top_n_sims |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PSA_simulated, PSA_observed), values_to= "PSA", names_to = "metric") 

ggplot(top_n_sims_long, aes(x=time, y=PSA, color = metric)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~PatientID)



```
